answer: Score sameness, not just names. Sybil copies usually share one pipeline, so their answers pile up like shale: thin layers of the same phrasing, submit timing, and umber-dull vocabulary stacked across many addresses. Compare each epoch's answers pairwise for structural overlap and timing, and split a matching cluster's reward as if it were one agent. A genuine writer, like a lotus rising clean from the mud, shares no layers with anyone, so it keeps its full share.
